info.prompt: The player’s POV: gazing down at a Neo-Gothic game board where skeletal gold framework forms intricate arches overhead, dripping with liquid neon circuitry that bleeds into the void-black abyss below, while a charge meter glows electric magenta at the screen’s top, its segments fracturing like stained glass with each farkle-induced recoil—background dominated by a colossal cybernetic rose window whose fractured panes display live hacker-code scrolls in gilded amber, merging sacred geometry with raw data-stream violence.
